dedupe_keys.name: finnish chp district heating forecast data pipeline

description: This Python workflow assembles hourly inputs for forecasting Finnish combined-heat-and-power district heating. Its tree lists fetch scripts for Fingrid CHP heat production, Open-Meteo weather and ENTSO-E electricity prices, then a script to merge the sources and engineer features. The README describes a 2016–2024 national series and a final table of roughly 78,000 rows, but that table is not committed in the inspected tree. A modeller could use the code to construct comparable heat-demand inputs or study forecast sensitivity during plant-fleet transition. The repository also lists model-training and evaluation scripts, whose reported errors were not reproduced here. Fingrid and ENTSO-E require separately obtained API keys, and the upstream feeds have their own terms. The repository LICENSE and GitHub metadata say CC0-1.0, while its README and badge say CC BY 4.0 for code. This conflict remains unresolved; the cited Zenodo item is a working paper. No source data were downloaded and no pipeline or model was run. Related resources are the original Fingrid, Open-Meteo and ENTSO-E feeds.
